WWEATHER WARS
How to playPlay now

FIELD MANUAL / 01

Win the weather war.

Finish turn ten with more money than your rival. Every round has three quick decisions: claim, build, and command the weather.

01⌖

Claim a territory

Choose one unclaimed tile. Look ahead: neighboring tiles of the same terrain earn up to a 40% adjacency bonus.

02▦

Build your economy

Place one building you can afford. Terrain matters—solar thrives in deserts, mines in mountains, and farms on grassland.

03ϟ

Command the forecast

Spend money on a weather card. Boost your own production or damage and suppress your opponent’s infrastructure.

04↻

Collect and adapt

Production is paid, maintenance is deducted, effects tick down, and the rival acts. A new hand arrives every turn.
